text:
Evelyn (AE): Prospect requires BYOK with their AWS CloudHSM (FIPS 140-2 L3). They want: a short hands-on POC checklist that proves encrypt/decrypt + rotation, a procurement-friendly cost stub (is there a per-CMK monthly line?), and clear wording about escrow/split-knowledge.
Samir (Solutions Eng): I can produce a compact POC script for them to follow during the kickoff. Plan: prove basic ops (Encrypt/Decrypt), measure KMS call latency, then run an alias swap and rewrap test so they can pick the rotation mode. I'll include a demo failover that uses a labeled non-HSM demo key for UI continuity.
Priyanka (Security): Security guardrails: require CloudTrail KMS events forwarded to their log account; require a key policy that denies ScheduleKeyDeletion and disallows root disabling without a documented process; prefer aws:SourceVpc or aws:SourceIp conditions. For escrow: default stance is NO copies retained by Redwood for BYOK CloudHSM flows unless explicitly contracted and detailed in the SOW with ceremony controls.
Diego (SRE): Network & ops: for zero-key-material-leaves-account we must run Redwood Private in their VPC or support an on-prem HSM. We'll need VPC peering/Transit GW details, a CIDR allowlist, and an assumable IAM role ARN for redwood-service (or a KMS Grant token). Also need a rotation maintenance window and an ops on-call contact.
Evelyn (AE): Procurement specifically asked if HSM-backed CMKs lead to a recurring Redwood charge per key.
Diego (SRE): Short answer: If the HSM is in their account (CloudHSM) AWS bills them; we include a one-time integration SOW (network + key ceremony validation) and a recurring Private ops fee if we host the private control plane in their VPC. Hosted customers using our managed keys do not see a per-CMK pass-through. I'll put placeholder numbers in the SOW draft for procurement review.
Samir (Solutions Eng): POC checklist (concise):
1) Customer creates an HSM-backed CMK in their AWS account and tags it for the POC.
2) Customer either: (A) creates a KMS Grant for the Redwood service principal, or (B) adds a Key Policy entry granting our assumable role Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey.
3) Provide CMK ARN and role/grant details to Redwood.
4) Run encrypt/decrypt calls through Redwood; capture p95/p99 latency for KMS calls.
5) Rotation test: run alias-swap (transparent) and also run rewrap-test (create new key + re-encrypt sample objects) depending on chosen flow.
6) Failure simulation: revoke grant to demonstrate labeled non-HSM fallback (demo only).
Priyanka (Security): Add security items to runbook: require CloudTrail forwarding, set alerting on repeated kms:Decrypt failures, and document retention (we recommend 90 days). Add a line that any key escrow/copy must be SOWed and executed with a split-knowledge ceremony for on-prem HSMs.
Samir (Solutions Eng): Example key policy snippet to hand to their infra (they must replace ARNs/account IDs):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"123456789012"}}},{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"*"},"Action":["kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion","kms:DisableKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Priyanka (Security): Recommend adding Conditions for aws:SourceVpc and aws:SourceIp where possible. Also tie any deletion exception to an SOW ticket number.
Evelyn (AE): Timeline: they want a kickoff within 2-3 weeks. What's realistic?
Diego (SRE): If they supply account access, peering and security contacts quickly: POC-ready environment in ~7-10 business days. Full Private + CloudHSM integration (network, key ceremony, validation) ~4-6 weeks. On-prem HSM adds vendor lead times (~8-12 weeks).
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-1145 for "Placeholder pricing: CloudHSM pass-through + integration SOW + Private ops fee".
Evelyn (AE): Action items: Samir assemble the one-page POC + sample payloads; Diego draft cost stub for procurement; Priyanka prepare questionnaire responses and flag any legal review items. I'll collect and send the kickoff invite when pack is ready.
Samir (Solutions Eng): I'll post the POC one-pager and a short test harness by EOD tomorrow.
Priyanka (Security): I'll attach the templated questionnaire answers and mark any high-risk clauses.
Diego (SRE): I'll add a note about measuring KMS call tail latencies (p99) so we can set SLOs in the SOW.
Evelyn (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll close the loop here and update the prospect.
